email.subject: Coral Co's site may be losing you bookings
email.body:
Hi Ivy,

I took a quick look at Coral Co Hair Studio's website. Two things stood out: it isn't mobile-friendly, and there's no click-to-call button. Since most people search for a salon on their phone and expect to tap straight through to call, both of these likely mean lost bookings every week.

I also noticed there's no online booking option and no hours listed, which can push undecided visitors to a competitor's site instead.

I fix exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you what's happening and what I'd fix first? No obligation.

Alex
Northlight Web
